verses.text: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
lines: Praise Yah!
Praise Yahweh, my soul.

verses.text: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
lines: While I live, I will praise Yahweh.
I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

verses.text: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
lines: Don’t put your trust in princes,
in a son of man in whom there is no help.

verses.text: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
lines: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth.
In that very day, his thoughts perish.

verses.text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
lines: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help,
whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:

verses.text: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
lines: who made heaven and earth,
the sea, and all that is in them;
who keeps truth forever;

verses.text: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
lines: who executes justice for the oppressed;
who gives food to the hungry.
Yahweh frees the prisoners.

verses.text: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
lines: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind.
Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down.
Yahweh loves the righteous.

verses.text: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
lines: Yahweh preserves the foreigners.
He upholds the fatherless and widow,
but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

verses.text: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
lines: Yahweh will reign forever;
your God, O Zion, to all generations.
Praise Yah!
